title: Symmetry under absolute displacement
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, let $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$. The symmetric average length at displacement $|t|$ and parameter $c$ equals its value at displacement $t$ and parameter $c$.
replaced: For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $a,b,t,c\in\mathbb R$, and $u,v\in\mathbb R^m$, define $L(t,c)=\frac12\bigl(\sqrt{P(a+tb)^2+c+\|u+tv\|_2^2}+\sqrt{P(a-tb)^2+c+\|u-tv\|_2^2}\bigr)$. For all parameters, $L(|t|,c)=L(t,c)$.
